purpose: The seed installation's Notice vocabulary: fixed-text labels applied to pages whose standing needs a visible caution. The wording lives here only; a page carries the block, never its own paraphrase.

notices.title: Source integrity questioned
notices.applicability: Mechanical: the page is a source page whose latest integrity grade in evaluation/source-grades.jsonl is 'questioned'.
notices.fixed_text: This page rests on a source whose integrity this wiki grades **questioned** in the source-grades register (`evaluation/source-grades.jsonl`): a specific assertion of that source stands unverified on the source's own terms. Read the page as a faithful account of what the source says, not as established fact, until the grade is resolved.

notices.title: Claim under negative treatment
notices.applicability: Mechanical: evaluation/treatment-register.jsonl holds a treatment event with grade 'negative' whose subject.page is this page.
notices.fixed_text: At least one claim carried on this page has been treated **negative** in the treatment register (`evaluation/treatment-register.jsonl`): the claim as stated was superseded, reversed, or corrected, and it is severed from retrieval. The page keeps the claim visible, under this notice, because the record of what was believed is part of the evidence.

notices.title: Personal material, owner-supplied
notices.applicability: Stated rule: the page's frontmatter sources include material the owner supplied from their own records, marked personal in the source register.
notices.fixed_text: This page is compiled from personal material the owner supplied from their own records. It is held to the same citation standard as every other page, and it is classified personal: it does not leave this installation, and no export carries it without the owner's ruling.

notices.title: As-written design record — later decisions govern
notices.applicability: Stated rule: a design or synthesis page preserved as written whose statements a later decision may have superseded.
notices.fixed_text: This page is a design record preserved **as written** on its date. Parts of it may state positions that later decisions have superseded; where this page and the decisions of record differ, the decisions govern. The page is kept verbatim because the history of the design is evidence, not because every sentence in it is current.

notices.title: Attribution incomplete
notices.applicability: Mechanical: a compiled page (type source/entity/concept/synthesis/query) whose frontmatter sources list is missing or empty.
notices.fixed_text: This compiled page cites **no sources**: the record it rests on is missing or was never attached. Its claims are unattributed on this wiki's own standard and should be treated as unverified until sources are attached and the page is re-compiled.
